content: Interventions for established stretch marks include various treatment modalities aimed at improving their appearance and texture. These treatments may involve topical therapies, such as retinoids, which promote collagen production and skin remodeling. Laser therapies, including fractional laser and pulsed dye laser, are commonly used to target the discoloration and stimulate dermal repair. Microneedling is another technique that induces collagen synthesis through controlled skin injury. Chemical peels, utilizing agents like glycolic acid, can help exfoliate the skin and enhance its overall texture. Additionally, radiofrequency treatments are employed to tighten the skin and improve elasticity. Each intervention is tailored to the individual’s skin type, the severity of the stretch marks, and their specific aesthetic goals.
